newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were little changed on Friday, traders said.

Dealers said they saw at least five cargoes being actively offered. One of these, a very prompt piece containing over two percent water, was thought to have been available on the vessel Moskovskiy Festival at around $3 over the mean/mean/mean of published quotes.
One dealer said he thought this was likely to move into ARA. A trader was offering an F-5 cargo, with viscosity at under two Engler, into the Med at $10 over the mean/mean/mean.
